reading: the turn read, diffed and cross-checked the package for eight and a half minutes and wrote no file; the operator killed it with no side effects. The exit code the dispatcher records (4294967295 = -1) and its ERR_LANE_ALL_ROUTES_EXHAUSTED label are artefacts of that kill, not evidence that every route failed - a stale-process reaping quirk worth knowing before anyone reads this code as a routing verdict.

side_effects.note: verified after termination: git status clean besides staging

follow_up.lesson: a bounded writer works when the artefact is one file and exactly specified; open-ended authoring does not
